name: ring-wave
title: Ring Wave
description: Concentric rings of arcs on canvas, like a sci-fi readout. Each arc's sweep rises and falls and each ring turns at its own speed; rings mix solid, segmented and tick kinds at different thicknesses, picked by a seed or set with a layout. Grow, cascade, spectrum and orbit patterns or a controlled value; per-ring or sweep gradients with palettes, glow, faint tracks, an intro where arcs grow from a point, and centered children.
